info.title: cb
info.description: Named, colour-coded Claude Code sessions in Windows Terminal tabs that come back after a reboot.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: BitMagic ClaudeBox 0.3.1: named, restorable Claude Code sessions. On its own, cb starts a session in this folder.

options.description: Show help and usage information

options.description: Show version information

options.name: --here
options.description: Run in this tab instead of opening a new one (keeps this tab's colours) [default: False]

commands.name: new
commands.description: Start a new named Claude session

options.name: --dir
options.description: Folder to run Claude in (default: current folder)

options.name: --work
options.description: Work type from config.json, e.g. hotfix

options.name: --colour
options.description: Tab colour (#RRGGBB or a name); overrides the work type's

options.name: --replace
options.description: Same as --on-clash replace [default: False]

options.name: --rename-pattern
options.description: Pattern for a free name, e.g. "{name} {n}"

commands.description: List sessions

options.name: --all
options.description: Include sessions closed more than two weeks ago [default: False]

commands.description: Reopen sessions that were running when Windows shut down

options.description: Reopen every session that isn't running, not just interrupted ones [default: False]

options.name: --work
options.description: Reopen every session of this work type that isn't running

options.name: --new-window
options.description: Open the tabs in a new window [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be restored without opening anything [default: False]

options.name: --missing
options.description: If a session's transcript is gone: fresh (start a new conversation), skip or remove (default: ask)

commands.name: rm
commands.description: Remove a session from cb

options.name: --exited
options.description: Remove every session that was exited or closed (not interrupted ones) [default: False]

options.name: --work
options.description: Remove every session of this work type that isn't running

options.name: --yes
options.description: Don't ask before removing several sessions [default: False]

options.name: --forget-transcript
options.description: Also delete Claude's transcript of the conversation [default: False]

arguments.name: SESSION
arguments.description: Session name, number from 'cb ls', or id prefix

options.description: Name for it (default: the conversation's title)

options.description: Tab colour (#RRGGBB or a name); overrides the work type's

options.description: Run in this tab instead of opening a new one (keeps this tab's colours) [default: False]

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Just add it; don't resume it now [default: False]

options.name: --running
options.description: Add every Claude session that's running now, from any folder (they're left open where they are) [default: False]

arguments.name: SESSION_ID
arguments.description: Claude's session ID, or the start of it (default: pick from this folder's sessions)
